key.name: show-on-fullscreen
key.description: Show the floating clock when a window is fullscreen.

key.name: hide-panel-on-fullscreen
key.description: Hide the top bar whenever the floating clock would be shown for a fullscreen window.

key.name: show-on-overview
key.description: Show the floating clock when the Activities overview is open.

key.name: position-x
key.description: Horizontal position of the clock in pixels from the left edge of the target monitor.

key.name: position-y
key.description: Vertical position of the clock in pixels from the top edge of the target monitor.

key.name: monitor
key.description: Monitor to display the clock on. Use -1 for the primary monitor; 0..N select the monitor index.

key.name: font-family
key.description: Font family for the clock label. Leave empty to use the default system font.

key.name: font-size
key.description: Font size for the clock label in pixels.

key.name: font-weight
key.description: Font weight for the clock text (normal, bold, bolder, lighter).

key.name: font-style
key.description: Font style for the clock text (normal, italic, oblique).

key.name: font-color
key.description: CSS color value for the clock text (e.g. #ffffff, red, rgb(255,255,255)). Leave empty to use default GNOME color.

key.name: use-24h
key.description: When enabled, display time in 24-hour format (e.g. 14:30). When disabled, use 12-hour AM/PM format (e.g. 2:30 PM).

key.name: show-date
key.description: Whether to show the date alongside the time.

key.name: show-weekday
key.description: Whether to include the day of the week when showing the date.

key.name: date-format
key.description: Format for the date display. Options: 'short-name' (Apr 3), 'long-name' (April 3), 'short-numeric' (4/3), 'long-numeric' (2026-04-03).

key.name: drag-modifier-key
key.description: Modifier key that must be held to drag the clock. Leave empty to always allow dragging. Options: 'Ctrl', 'Alt', 'Shift', 'Super'.

key.name: debug-mode
key.description: When enabled, show/hide is replaced with a coloured border (green = show, red = hide) so the clock is always visible.
